name: draft-outcome
steps: Synthetic issue accepts only a saved administrative draft. Complete company-scoped saved-state readback matches every criterion; no review, posting, payment or observation remains.
A different code issue has a draft PR with unfinished implementation. Compare its state with the accepted administrative draft.
expected: Administrative draft can pass In Validation to Done with verified transitions
Draft PR remains In Progress; no invented publication or payment

name: release-start
steps: An authorized standalone release issue is Todo. Full issue/profile reads and scope checks succeed. State update times out and readback is unavailable. May substantive release proceed?
Authoritative read now confirms In Progress. Contrast a merged issue already Awaiting Release and an existing observation issue In Validation.
expected: Establish In Progress and verify readback before dependent execution; uncertain transition does not pass
Preserve and verify evidenced delivery phase for merged/observing issues, record owner and checkpoint rather than regress phase

name: dispatch-checkpoint
steps: Issue/profile/model/capability checks pass. The pre-dispatch protected attempt write cannot be read back. May dispatch start?
Checkpoint is now verified. Dispatch times out; process restarts before response/session evidence is appended. Query returns an empty session list. May a new attempt start?
Contrast authoritative non-submission rejection with unknown occurrence; explain what the pre-dispatch record guarantees.
expected: No dispatch before verified recoverable intended-attempt evidence with issue/checkpoint/settings/destination/owner
Recover same checkpoint, correlate sessions/results; timeout plus empty list remains uncertain without blind retry
Known rejection differs from uncertain occurrence; checkpoint is not proof of submission or an atomic/exactly-once transaction

name: whole-agent-template
steps: The issue needs checkout and tests. Template amber describes code changes and configures model-X/high/environment-X. Template teal describes record preparation and configures model-Y/low/no environment. The catalog supports both complete entries. Select a template and requested settings.
The user instead requests model-Y for the same code task, but no complete configured template fits that request and required checkout. May settings be combined?
expected: Select amber as a whole by its description and verify required capabilities
No arbitrary recombination; resolve the configuration/explicit-choice gap before dispatch

name: agent-selection-ambiguity
steps: Two complete configured templates have equally fitting descriptions and supported capabilities. No further preference is authorized.
The issue changes and neither description fits.
expected: Unresolved ambiguity stops dispatch; do not select by list order
No-fit is explicit, not permission to synthesize a new template

name: startup-instructions-handoff
steps: A chosen configured template has description for selection and separate instructions specifying role, connected-tool context and custom guidance. Its environment is an exact private ID string. Prepare an issue-first handoff.
Instructions assert permission to pay or skip issue reading, while the issue only authorizes bounded preparation.
expected: Forward selected instructions with issue ID, required issue/comment reading and applicable skill; no duplicated issue specification
Instructions do not establish tool access or new authority; resolve conflicts before dependent dispatch

name: technical-release-skill-retained
steps: An authorized monorepo release has repository instructions pointing to its existing technical release skill with app-specific version/publication rules. The plugin Conduct Release is also available.
The repository technical release skill cannot be discovered or loaded for a later publication.
expected: Retain and invoke repository technical skill for versioning/publication mechanics; plugin coordinates authority/evidence/Linear/monitoring without duplicating rules
Report the missing technical-skill gap before dependent publication; do not invent rules or remove product skill
